# Vendored third-party code

These files are unmodified upstream builds except for one appended
`export default ...;` line each, so they can be used as native ES
modules without a bundler.

## `qrcode-generator.js`

- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Fetched: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js`
- Version: 1.4.4
- License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase — see file header)

## `jsQR.js`

- Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
- Fetched: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js`
- Version: 1.4.0
- License: Apache-2.0
